svg.title: C06-M05-F1: One root cause, two cures
svg.desc: A diagram showing untrusted data reaching a SQL string (cured by parameterisation) or HTML output (cured by output encoding), under the shared rule to keep data as data.
svg.text: C06-M05-F1 One root cause, two cures
ROOT CAUSE: untrusted DATA interpreted as CODE/markup
input -> SQL string => SQL injection => cure: parameterise (bind data)
input -> HTML output => cross-site scr. => cure: encode output (as text)
keep data as data; never let input cross into the code/markup channel
Figure C06-M05-F1. Injection and XSS share a root cause and have matching cures:
